pages.promptText:
REG-KS7R

The first line is a prompt identifier only. Never render it as text in the image.

A documentary photograph for a travel magazine, very close: a private, unposed moment, taken by a photographer she has forgotten. Vertical 3:4, one continuous photograph filling the frame edge to edge.

REFERENCES: The face photo is HER: reproduce her face, freckles, skin and her very short dark-brown pixie-cut hair exactly from it, from any angle; she is in her mid-thirties, slim and tall. The headless outfit photo shows how the outfit is worn together and its proportions (ignore anything above its neck). The product photos define each garment's exact colour and construction; take only the named garment from each. The location photos (including a still from the film of the same day, the reel reference) define the real place, its stone, railings and architecture only — not the viewpoint, the weather, the time of day or the people.

OUTFIT, exactly as the product photos, nothing added (one outfit all day, never changed):
- Knit coat: a chunky black-and-white mixed-yarn (salt-and-pepper marl) knit coat, a wide SHAWL collar that rolls down into the front, two black buttons, dropped shoulders, very full balloon sleeves gathered into a narrower cuff, knee length. In this picture the coat is taken off (see ACTION).
- Shirt: ink-blue (deep blue-violet) and white striped cotton shirt: thin white VERTICAL stripes on the body and sleeves, and a rectangular bib on the chest where the stripes run HORIZONTALLY; a pointed collar, small buttons; tucked into the skirt. 
- Skirt: dark brown (almost black) crocodile-embossed leather skirt, high waist, straight and slim, below the knee, a horizontal seam a little above the hem.
- Black opaque tights.
- Boots: black suede ankle boots with a square toe and a low, thick block heel. 
- Bag: a smoky grey-green smooth leather hobo bag with exactly ONE wide shoulder handle making a single arch (no second handle, no crossbody strap). In this picture the bag is put down (see ACTION).
No jewellery, no watch, no rings, no earrings, no scarf, no hat, no gloves, no sunglasses.

WEATHER (the same all day): A clear, dry November day: a low southern sun with long shadows, a light silvery haze over the sea, a steady sea wind, dry ground. No rain, no puddles, no wet streets, no clouds of rain, no snow. It is now night.

PLACE RULES: southern Italy (Calabria), November. No readable text anywhere: no shop names, no brand names, no station name boards, no logos.

PLACE: the same simple guesthouse room at night: Flat, smoothly painted plain white to off-white walls (modern emulsion paint, even, no stains, no patches, no plaster texture). The louvred shutters are painted a muted sage grey-green. A terracotta tile floor, a simple bed with a plain white cover, an old wooden chair, a small bedside table with a lamp. It is 20:40, full night: the window behind the half-closed louvred shutters is DARK — black-blue night outside, no sky light, no daylight at all. Through the gaps between the slats only a few thin warm orange lines of street light show, and nothing else.

SHOT: about 2 metres away at seated height, from her front-left at about 35 degrees, 50mm: she sits on the edge of the bed, framed from her head to her feet on the floor.

ACTION: the knit coat hangs over the back of the wooden chair, the bag on its seat. She sits on the edge of the bed in the striped shirt, its top button open, the shirt still tucked into the leather skirt, black tights; she has just pulled off her right ankle boot, which stands on the floor beside the left boot she still wears; her right foot in black tights rests on the wooden floor, her hands on the edge of the bed. A tired, private pause at the end of the day.

ATTITUDE: she is completely absorbed in the moment and unaware of the camera. Nothing is arranged for the camera.

FACE: she looks down at the floor, eyelids lowered, lips closed, quiet; never looking at the camera.

LIGHT: only the warm amber bedside lamp from her right: soft light on her face, the stripes and the curve of her calf in the tights; the rest of the room in deep warm shadow. No flash.

LENS AND FILM: Leica M6, Summicron 35mm, Kodak Portra 400, handheld, available light only. Visible, textured film grain over the whole frame. Warm, natural colour: sunlit skin and pale surfaces keep a gentle warmth, greens and earth tones are rich but not oversaturated, shadows stay soft and slightly cool. No cut-out edge, no digital sharpening. True garment colours.

NEVER: a wooden floor, parquet, wooden floorboards, a different room, lying down, sleeping, the shirt unbuttoned below the second button, bare legs, bare shoulders, a robe, a television, a second person, a beach umbrella, sunbathers, a crowd, rain, wet ground, puddles, an overcast or grey sky, snow, flash photography, an on-camera flash look, a smile, a sad face, a rear view as the subject, long hair, a bob, a ponytail, changed garments, a second bag, a bag with two handles, a crossbody strap, jewellery, a wristwatch, rings, nail polish, bare legs, white socks, sneakers, added text or logos, readable signs or letters, watermarks, borders, studio lights, a view from directly above, an elongated body, a younger or rounder face, a second person in focus, extra fingers, a third hand, a hand on the hip, looking at the camera, posing for the camera, a fashion pose.

REG-KS7R

A real 35mm film still photograph, vertical 9:16, from a quiet documentary film: a still life on the SAME old wooden table as in the reference photo (worn, scratched dark-oak planks), with the SAME bedside lamp with the rough linen shade and the bronze base, in the same dim room at night, the same low warm lamplight and deep warm shadows.

ON THE TABLE, the traces of a perfumer's day of research: several sheets of plain cream notepaper with small, quick pencil handwriting (the words too small to read), one line firmly crossed out with pencil strokes and rewritten below; six thin white perfumer's smelling strips (long narrow strips of thick white blotter paper, each about 13 cm long and 7 mm wide) laid out in a neat fan, the tip of each faintly stained a different pale yellow-green with bergamot oil, a tiny pencil number written on each strip; a short sharpened pencil; a pair of thin, slightly worn tortoiseshell reading glasses folded on the corner of the paper; and the curl of green bergamot peel from the reference, slightly dried. At the edge of the table, the old brass key with the black silk tassel and the three coins from the reference.

CAMERA: low, close to the table surface, about 50 cm away, looking along the table at a shallow angle (never from directly above), 50mm, shallow depth of field: the fan of smelling strips and the crossed-out line sharp in the middle third; the lamp soft at the top; the key and coins soft at the bottom edge.

LIGHT: only the lamp, from the upper left: warm amber light raking across the paper so the pencil marks, the oil stains on the strips and the texture of the peel catch the light; the rest of the room falls into deep warm shadow.

FILM: Leica M6, Summicron 50mm, Kodak Portra 800 pushed one stop, handheld, visible film grain, slightly soft, gentle halation around the lamp, lifted warm-brown blacks. A real photograph, no readable text, no logos, no people, no hands.

A real 35mm film photograph, horizontal 3:2, for a fashion magazine: an intimate, sensual, elegant late-night moment, adult and tasteful, never vulgar, no nudity.

REFERENCES: the first image is HER face (a French woman in her mid-thirties, very short dark-brown pixie-cut hair, freckles, slim). The second image is the room (plain white walls, sage grey-green louvred shutters half closed, a white bed, a low bedside lamp). The third image shows her shirt (ink-blue and white stripes). The fourth image shows THE GESTURE ONLY: the bare inside of her wrist held under her nose to smell the scent on it — copy that hand and wrist position, nothing else from it.

THE MOMENT: she lay down to smell the bergamot still on her wrist and fell asleep like that. She lies FULLY DOWN on her side on the white bed, her head resting heavily on the pillow, her body stretched out and completely relaxed, her shoulders down on the mattress — she is NOT propped up on an elbow, NOT half sitting. Her right forearm lies on the pillow in front of her face, bent so that the hand curls back toward her chest and the PALM SIDE of the wrist — the soft pale inner wrist with faint blue veins, NOT the back of the hand, NOT the knuckles — rests just under her nose, a couple of centimetres away, as if she was breathing it in when sleep took her. Her fingers loose and slightly curled, relaxed. Eyes closed, lashes down, lips softly parted in sleep, her face soft and heavy with sleep. Her left arm lies loosely along her side.

WHAT SHE WEARS: the striped shirt with the top three buttons open, the collar fallen open to her collarbones and the base of her throat; the dark crocodile-leather skirt; black sheer tights.

CAMERA: low at mattress height, close, about 80 cm from her face, from the front, 50mm, shallow depth of field: her face, the inner wrist and the open collar sharp; the room soft behind.

LIGHT: only the low amber bedside lamp from beyond her head: warm light on her cheek, closed eyelids, the inner wrist and the collarbone; deep warm shadows. Underexposed.

FILM: Kodak Portra 800 pushed, visible grain, real skin texture, no retouching. No text.
